title: TransferApproval
description: Immutable approval of an exact staged plan and bounded scope.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

job_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

plan_digest.description: Exact graph and baseline digest approved.

plan_manifest_id.description: Protected immutable manifest reviewed by this approval. Must match the approved digest and exact plan revision.
plan_manifest_id.x-reference-scope: Exact clean StorageObject owned by this transfer plan and Institution.

reviewer_principal_id.description: Authorized actor or service identity for the recorded operation.
reviewer_principal_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

approval_kind.description: Which owner gate the decision satisfies.

scope_keys.description: Concrete scopes approved by this actor.

x-invariants: Approvals cannot be edited or moved to a new plan revision.
Reviewer authority is revalidated before activation.
An export projection approval pins both the frozen selection and the exact capability and loss report digest. Required losses cannot be approved into a successful output.
